summary: Introduces secret masking (ansible-core 2.22+): registered secrets are replaced with $REDACTED$ on screen, in log_path, callback output and module logs, while the real value is still used by tasks.
questions: How does Ansible hide secrets in its output?
What does $REDACTED$ mean in Ansible output?
Does masking change the actual variable value?

answer_card.title: Secret masking overview
answer_card.answer_md: Since ansible-core 2.22, registered secrets are replaced with **`$REDACTED$`** on screen, in the `log_path` file, in callback output, and in module logs on the managed node. The actual value isn't changed, so tasks, templates and modules still use the real value.
